name: MExpr.eval_lit
stmt: @[simp] theorem MExpr.eval_lit (n : ℕ) : MExpr.eval (.lit n) = n

name: MExpr.eval_neg
stmt: @[simp] theorem MExpr.eval_neg (e : MExpr) : MExpr.eval (.neg e) = 0

name: MExpr.eval_iff
stmt:
@[simp] theorem MExpr.eval_iff (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    MExpr.eval (.iff s₁ s₂) = MStmt.run s₁ + MStmt.run s₂

name: MStmt.run_skip
stmt: @[simp] theorem MStmt.run_skip : MStmt.run .skip = 0

name: MStmt.run_seq
stmt:
@[simp] theorem MStmt.run_seq (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    MStmt.run (.seq s₁ s₂) = MStmt.run s₁ + MStmt.run s₂ + 1

name: MStmt.run_guard
stmt: @[simp] theorem MStmt.run_guard (e : MExpr) : MStmt.run (.guard e) = MExpr.eval e + 1

name: flatSize
doc:
**扁平尺寸**：对 `Flat` 自身结构递归，`inl`/`inr` 两侧**互相调用**。
关键：它**不**调用 `MExpr.size` / `MStmt.size`——两套定义彼此独立，
故第 6 节的等价定理是有内容的。
stmt:
def flatSize : Flat → ℕ
  | .inl (.lit _) => 1
  | .inl (.neg e) => flatSize (.inl e) + 1
  | .inl (.iff s₁ s₂) => flatSize (.inr s₁) + flatSize (.inr s₂) + 1
  | .inr .skip => 1
  | .inr (.seq s₁ s₂) => flatSize (.inr s₁) + flatSize (.inr s₂) + 1
  | .inr (.guard e) => flatSize (.inl e) + 1

                 

                                                                      
                                     

mutual
                                            
  def flatVal : Flat → ℕ
    | .inl (.lit n) => n
    | .inl (.neg _) => 0
    | .inl (.iff s₁ s₂) => flatRun (.inr s₁) + flatRun (.inr s₂)
    | .inr _ => 0

                                           
  def flatRun : Flat → ℕ
    | .inl _ => 0
    | .inr .skip => 0
    | .inr (.seq s₁ s₂) => flatRun (.inr s₁) + flatRun (.inr s₂) + 1
    | .inr (.guard e) => flatVal (.inl e) + 1
end

name: flatSize_inl_lit
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatSize_inl_lit (k : ℕ) : flatSize (.inl (.lit k)) = 1

name: flatSize_inl_neg
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatSize_inl_neg (e : MExpr) : flatSize (.inl (.neg e)) = flatSize (.inl e) + 1

name: flatSize_inl_iff
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatSize_inl_iff (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    flatSize (.inl (.iff s₁ s₂)) = flatSize (.inr s₁) + flatSize (.inr s₂) + 1

name: flatSize_inr_skip
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatSize_inr_skip : flatSize (.inr (.skip : MStmt)) = 1

name: flatSize_inr_seq
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatSize_inr_seq (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    flatSize (.inr (.seq s₁ s₂)) = flatSize (.inr s₁) + flatSize (.inr s₂) + 1

name: flatSize_inr_guard
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatSize_inr_guard (e : MExpr) :
    flatSize (.inr (.guard e)) = flatSize (.inl e) + 1

name: flatVal_inl_lit
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatVal_inl_lit (k : ℕ) : flatVal (.inl (.lit k)) = k

name: flatVal_inl_neg
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatVal_inl_neg (e : MExpr) : flatVal (.inl (.neg e)) = 0

name: flatVal_inl_iff
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatVal_inl_iff (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    flatVal (.inl (.iff s₁ s₂)) = flatRun (.inr s₁) + flatRun (.inr s₂)

name: flatVal_inr
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatVal_inr (s : MStmt) : flatVal (.inr s) = 0

name: flatRun_inl
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatRun_inl (e : MExpr) : flatRun (.inl e) = 0

name: flatRun_inr_skip
stmt: @[simp] theorem flatRun_inr_skip : flatRun (.inr (.skip : MStmt)) = 0

name: flatRun_inr_seq
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatRun_inr_seq (s₁ s₂ : MStmt) :
    flatRun (.inr (.seq s₁ s₂)) = flatRun (.inr s₁) + flatRun (.inr s₂) + 1

name: flatRun_inr_guard
stmt:
@[simp] theorem flatRun_inr_guard (e : MExpr) :
    flatRun (.inr (.guard e)) = flatVal (.inl e) + 1
